print("=== MeRIP: top Hyper m6A + Up DEG genes ===")

print("\n=== MeRIP: top Hypo m6A + Down DEG genes ===")

print(hypo_down[['gene_name','m_log2FC','g_log2FC','Class']].head(10).to_string())

# Check proteomics: top up/down significant proteins

print("\n=== Proteomic: top down-regulated proteins (Tumor vs Normal) ===")
sig_down = prot[(prot['is_sig']==True) & (prot['log2FC']<0)].nsmallest(5,'log2FC')

# Check if Normal/Tumor columns have repeated values suggesting averaged data
print("\n=== Proteomic Normal unique value count:", prot['Normal'].nunique())
print("=== Proteomic Tumor unique value count:", prot['Tumor'].nunique())
